translations.source_sense_description: ohne ein brauchbares Ergebnis zu erzeugen

glosses: Having no point or sharp tip; terminating squarely or in a rounded end.

examples.text: a pointless sword
a pointless knife

glosses: Having no prominent or important feature, as of an argument, discourse, etc.

examples.text: a pointless remark
The sequel to the film was even more pointless than the original

Even the numerous drunkards and beggars seemed to be in a hurry, stumbling from one side of the street to the other with pointless resolution or, with businesslike expeditiousness, soliciting money and food from strangers.

glosses: Having no purpose; purposeless; unable to effect an aim.

examples.text: Since the decision has already been made, further discussion seems pointless.

glosses: Having no points

examples.text: After four matches and four defeats, United remain pointless at the foot of the table.

glosses: Without points.

examples.text: a pointless topology

glosses: Point-free; employing the tacit programming paradigm.

translations.source_sense_description: ohne ein brauchbares Ergebnis zu erzeugen

glosses: Without use or possibility to be used.

examples.text: This fork's prongs are bent. It's useless now.
I'm all for opening new stations (Transport Scotland is planning another at East Linton, about halfway between Drem and Dunbar), but they are useless without a decent service.

glosses: Unhelpful, not useful; pointless (of an action).

examples.text: I think it's useless to keep this discussion going. It's like talking to a brick wall.
I tried my best to make him quit smoking, but my efforts were useless. He now smokes six packs a day.

glosses: Good-for-nothing; not dependable.

examples.text: Bill never mows the lawn, takes out the trash or anything. He's useless, but I love him anyways.

glosses: Unable to do well at a particular task or thing. Useless is mildly insulting.

examples.text: My brother is useless at most computer games, but he is an awesome PS2 player.
Why do you keep trying? You're obviously useless at it.

translations.source_sense_description: ohne ein brauchbares Ergebnis zu erzeugen

glosses: Incapable of producing results, useless; doomed not to be successful; not worth attempting.

examples.text: But Bathsheba, though she could feel, was not much given to futile dreaming, and her musings under this head were short and entirely confined to the times when Troy’s neglect was more than ordinarily evident.
He seemed hitherto to have been living by proxy, in a vision, in reflection—to have been an echo, a shadow, a futile attempt;[…]

No matter how early I came down, I would find him on the veranda, smoking cigarettes, or[…]. And at last I began to realize in my harassed soul that all elusion was futile, and to take such holidays as I could get, when he was off with a girl, in a spirit of thankfulness.

There is an hour or two, after the passengers have embarked, which is disquieting and fussy.[…]Stewards, carrying cabin trunks, swarm in the corridors. Passengers wander restlessly about or hurry, with futile energy, from place to place.
He wished he had not been saddled with Whippham's rather futile son as his chaplain.
Goals from Steven Pienaar, Andros Townsend, Jermain Defoe and Harry Kane sealed the win, but Rubin Kazan's 1-1 draw against PAOK Salonika rendered Spurs' efforts futile.

glosses: Insignificant; frivolous.

examples.text: Of its history little is recorded, and that little futile.
This idiosyncrasy is brought out by social pressure, while in a state of nature it might have betrayed itself only in trivial and futile ways, as it does among barbarians.

examples.text: Ai-je besoin de vous dire, après cela, que tout notre argent était dépensé en fantaisies inutiles de toilettes ?

Pour commencer, tu devrais fermer la porte. Inutile que des oreilles indiscrètes nous entendent nous disputer.

glosses: Personnage qui ne rend aucun service, dont l’activité n’apporte rien à quiconque.

examples.text: Toute une organisation formidable d’écumeurs et d’inutiles, vivant grassement, tripatouillant, combinant, s’enrichissant, sans produire quoi que ce fût d’utile.
